quotes.text: You have 15 calendar days from dispute creation to submit evidence.
If they don't, the payment attempt expires and the PaymentIntent returns to requires_payment_method.

old_evidence.text: The minimum charge limit is 29,00 EUR or the equivalent for other supported currencies.
You must submit the requested information within 12 calendar days.

substantive_changes: November adds explicit ES domestic buyer scope, EUR 29–3,000 range, B2B/B2C, instant provisional access and merchant/Connect account eligibility, with eligibility review and coded-category restrictions (old raw lines 8-56, 88-94; new raw lines 9-40 and 247-270).

Manual and partial capture shown, multi/over-capture and extended/incremental/decremental/re-authorization unsupported (new raw lines 272-286 and 355-399).

November documents desktop/mobile hosted redirect, 60-minute authorization and requires_payment_method expiry, payment confirmation before buyer return, standard payout schedule, and transaction-ID retrieval after completion (new raw lines 9-14 and 401-421).

November details post-payment lifecycle: buyer full-only disputes and filing/decision/evidence timing, single evidence round, balance holds, and noncancelable refunds with installment-plan behavior and final Refund status (old raw lines 292-323; new raw lines 288-353).
historical_claims_to_preserve: May 6 showed EU customers, ES merchant location, EU/Southern Europe framing, EUR, 3 interest-free or up to 12 installments, no recurring or Connect, standard payout and manual capture (old raw lines 8-56). Preserve historical statements even where November differs.

May Checkout setup and subscription exclusions and Express Checkout Element exclusion (old raw lines 58-66), and the separate May acceptance authorization-to-capture seven-day window versus November customer authorization timeout (raw/stripe-sequra-accept-payment-2025.md lines 1094-1103, 1122-1140).

Both captures describe 180-day refund window, up to five minutes asynchronously, `refund.updated`/`refund.failed`, and an alternative customer refund if Stripe returns funds to seller balance after failure (old raw lines 316-323 and new raw lines 288-312). The historical dispute evidence was 12 calendar days; November says 15.
conflicts: May method overview lists EU customer location, ES merchant/Stripe accounts, EUR and no Connect (old raw lines 8-38, 52-56 and 325-329). Its mapped source lines 13 and 17 conflate merchant territory with buyer scope and use present-tense No Connect. November specifies ES on both sides, domestic only, EUR, B2B/B2C account models, merchant and platform/marketplace account types, and instant provisional access subject to possible post-activation review (new raw lines 9-21, 35-40 and 247-262). May acceptance Checkout's broad Europe business-location label (raw/stripe-sequra-accept-payment-2025.md lines 16-35) is a separate dated tension, not current eligibility.

May dedicated method Connect No conflicts with May BNPL product matrix Connect Supported (raw/stripe-bnpl-overview-2025.md lines 40, 50). November dedicated Connect Yes and connected-account `sequra_payments` enabled requirement align with November matrix (raw/stripe-payments-buy-now-pay-later-2026-11-07.md lines 41, 51; new raw lines 365-399). Request at account creation or via update. Direct charges use the connected account as merchant of record and its bank statement descriptor according to the Connect section, while destination or transfer charges use the platform as merchant of record. Distinguish its buyer-facing statement prose at new raw lines 419-421, which says payments display SeQura and refers back to Connect rules. Preserve both scopes and do not assume one universal descriptor.

Old raw lines 28-30 and new raw 272-273 agree recurring payments are unsupported. The May BNPL matrix marked setup_future_usage Supported with the non-card/off_session footnote, while both November sources mark it unsupported (raw/stripe-bnpl-overview-2025.md lines 58, 67-71; raw/stripe-payments-buy-now-pay-later-2026-11-07.md lines 59, 68-72; new raw lines 374-384). The new method page lists Billing and Invoicing with send_invoice, while the November BNPL matrix lists Subscriptions Unsupported and Invoicing Supported with footnote. Do not convert Billing support into recurring, setup, off-session, Checkout subscription/setup mode or universal native support. In-app support now appears in the product list, with actual native SDK implementation outside these capture pins.

May raw lines 88-90 have the EUR 29 minimum but no stated maximum; November raw lines 255-270 add EUR 3,000 maximum. May term wording was three interest-free or up to 12 total installments (old raw line 8), while November only specifies choosing installments. Separately the May acceptance guide states 7–120 day repayment terms (raw/stripe-sequra-accept-payment-2025.md line 16), not the new 60-minute authorization deadline. Retain these as distinct dated descriptions rather than inferring removal.

May source line 23 and BNPL concept line 148 report 12 calendar days for evidence (old raw line 314). November changes evidence to 15 calendar days from creation, with 120 calendar days for filing after purchase, one dispute per payment, only full disputes, 25 calendar days from dispute creation for a decision and single evidence round (new raw lines 294-297 and 314-353). Keep the hold and return/permanent balance outcome. November newly details noncancelable asynchronous refund and installment-plan adjustments while preserving 180 days and up to five minutes and terminal Refund status events (old raw lines 316-323; new raw lines 288-312).

answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/sequra describes single-use SeQura installments for Spanish businesses and buyers, domestic EUR 29–3,000, B2B and B2C, and instant provisional access subject to possible eligibility review (new raw lines 9-40 and 247-270). Connect platforms need sequra_payments enabled on each accepting account. The charge type determines the documented merchant of record. Checkout sends line items automatically, while Payment Intents must supply amount_details[line_items] for SeQura to receive item details (new raw lines 386-399). Stripe redirects the buyer to SeQura on desktop or mobile to choose installments and authorize within 60 minutes. Timeout returns the Intent to requires_payment_method. Stripe documents immediate payment notification and standard payouts, separate from the customer's return (new raw lines 9-14 and 401-421). The capture supports manual or partial capture and send_invoice invoicing, with no recurring, setup, future usage or off-session payment support (new raw lines 272-297 and 365-384). The May overview (old raw lines 8-56, 88-90 and 292-323) had EU buyers, ES businesses, No Connect, only the EUR 29 minimum and 12 calendar days for dispute evidence. source-stripe-sequra.md still uses those dated limits and omits the November capture.
answers.Q2: The full November body at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/sequra changes documented buyer scope to domestic Spain, adds B2B eligibility, Connect with a capability prerequisite, the EUR 3,000 maximum, 60-minute authorization, line-item handling, invoicing and nuanced refund/dispute operations (new raw lines 15-40, 247-353 and 365-421). The May source must preserve EU buyer scope versus Spain merchant account geography, no Connect, 3 interest-free or up to 12 installments, EUR 29 minimum without a stated maximum, and 12-calendar-day evidence versus November's 15 (old raw lines 8-56, 88-90 and 292-323). The November installments choice does not establish removal of historical plans. Preserve the May BNPL matrix Connect and setup_future_usage Supported labels against May method Connect No and November payment-method and matrix evidence. November Billing and send_invoice invoicing do not prove Subscriptions or recurring. Category prose is regrouped and keyed by MCC, which adds explicit eligibility evidence but does not turn omission into permission. Navigation to separately dated acceptance instructions also persists (new raw lines 423-427). Update source-stripe-sequra.md with both raw dates and preserve root index line 7, Stripe index lines 346-347 and 747, and BNPL concept lines 268-269 with a source backlink.
